g.text: Smart LMS - W2: LMS skeleton and ingestion
UNIQUE(userId, role). Role assignment is authorized server-side.
Profiles store optional personal fields, not authorization.
grantedScopes restricts delegated administration; role alone is insufficient.
Prevent disabling/removing the last active administrator.
Admin scope does not automatically grant access to private content.
Course is the course/class permission boundary used in SRS.
No separate Classroom/cohort is defined in the current requirements.
Course teacherId must identify an authorized teacher.
Visibility/accessType/price live here only; no duplicate Course price.
FREE implies price = 0; PAID implies price > 0.
W2: teacher grants enrollment; self-join/payment come later.
Join code/password are hashed; never sent in public course metadata.
UNIQUE(userId, courseId). Revoke does not delete scores/submissions.
Authorize every request against current status and course scope.
Course progress is derived from eligible lesson completions.
New material defaults to PROTECTED: watermarked view, no clean download.
PUBLIC_DOWNLOAD: clean view/download for users already allowed to read.
This does not make the course public or grant enrollment.
A policy change increments policyRevision and invalidates cached access.
activeVersionId must refer to a READY version of this document.
UNIQUE(documentId, versionNumber). Original file remains private.
OCR/RAG reads the clean original, never the watermarked derivative.
Watermark failure must not fall back to a clean protected view.
W2 accepts text PDFs; other declared formats are for the final product.
W2: EXTRACTED != READY; indexedAt remains null until W3 indexing.
Activate a version for AI only after required extraction/index/view checks.
Old version stays active until replacement is ready; removed source is blocked.
Idempotency prevents duplicate extraction/chunks on retry.
Late workers cannot reactivate removed documents/versions.
A successful EXTRACT job alone does not mean RAG is ready.
UNIQUE(lessonId, documentId); both must belong to the same course.
Materials may be course-level without being linked to a lesson.
Convert relations into FKs, UNIQUE and CHECK constraints in the ERD/migrations.
Cross-entity rules require transactional service checks as well as FKs.
Dashboard/revenue/course progress are queries, not duplicate stored totals.
Blue / «W2»: prioritize in W2; not evidence of implementation.
FK labels identify foreign keys; nullable relations use 0..1.
PK = id: UUID. Money = Decimal, never Float.
State fields are closed values listed in notes, not arbitrary strings.
Relations do not prescribe ON DELETE CASCADE.
